source_clause: PVAL10.1) Once 4 digits are entered grey out all numeric buttons.
leaf_desc_037: PVAL10.1) Once 4 digits are entered grey out all numeric buttons.
reasoning: 驗證目標：12.10.1（PVAL10.1）—— 輸滿 4 碼後所有數字鍵變灰。關鍵情境條件：以 3 碼時可用為基準線（§5.6）。**來源標示（J-12）**：3 碼為測試設置。為什麼這樣切：Go 鍵之可用性屬 12.10，本條只管數字鍵。

tcs.tc_title: Numeric buttons greyed out once four digits are entered
tcs.test_item: Numeric buttons greyed out once four digits are entered
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The Valet Mode PIN entry popup is displayed
2. The vehicle is stationary
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Enter three digits and read the numeric buttons
2. Enter a fourth digit
3. Read the numeric buttons and check that they are greyed out
tcs.expected_result:
1. The numeric buttons are available with three digits entered
2. The fourth digit is entered
3. All numeric buttons are greyed out
tcs.priority_basis: 輸滿 4 碼後數字鍵變灰 —— 呈現細節
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
